camel_example: aliyun esa CreateSite --region cn-hangzhou --SiteName 'example.com' --InstanceId 'dbaudit-cn-nwy349jdb03' --Coverage domestic --AccessType NS
description_zh: 让用户创建一个新的站点
kebab_example: aliyun esa create-site --site-name example.com --coverage domestic --access-type NS --instance-id dbaudit-cn-nwy349jdb03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSite

parameters.help_en:
The acceleration region. Valid values:
domestic: the Chinese mainland only.
global: global.
overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland)
parameters.help_zh:
加速区域。取值：
domestic：仅中国内地。
global：全球。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）
parameters.name: coverage

parameters.help_en:
The access type of the site. Valid values:

NS: access by using managed NS.
CNAME: access by configuring a CNAME record
parameters.help_zh:
站点的接入类型。取值：

NS：表示使用托管NS的方式接入。
CNAME ：表示使用配置CNAME的方式接入
parameters.name: access_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852398.html operation to obtain the instance ID. You must specify at least one of the instance ID and site ID. If both are specified, the instance ID takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852398.html接口获取。实例ID和站点ID至少填写一个，若两者都填，则以实例ID为准进行查询
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the default resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。不传该参数时，系统自动补全默认资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

NameServerList.description_en: The list of name servers assigned to the site, separated by commas (,). This field has a value when the access type of the site is NS. You need to change the DNS servers of the site to these name servers. Then you can verify the site ownership and activate the site
NameServerList.description_zh: 为站点分配的NS列表，用半角逗号（,）分隔。当站点的接入方式为NS接入时，该字段有值，需要将站点的DNS服务器修改成这些NS。随后即可验证站点的归属权，激活站点

VerifyCode.description_en: The verification code of the site. When the access type of the site is CNAME, you need to add a TXT record with the record name _esaauth.[site name] and the record value set to the verification code on the DNS server of the site. Then you can verify the site ownership and activate the site
VerifyCode.description_zh:
站点的校验码。当站点的接入方式为CNAME接入时，需要在站点的DNS服务器下配置一条记录名称为_esaauth.[站点名称]
、记录值为校验码的TXT记录。随后即可验证站点的归属权，激活站点
